cleaned_description: The articles under consideration are automotive ball joints, models XNB20037, XNB20063 and XNB30110, used in suspension systems. You describe the automotive ball joints as core safety and functional components of the vehicle’s suspension, which connect the suspension and steering linkage mechanisms, enabling controlled multi-angle movement to adapt to dynamic driving and steering changes, They also bear the vehicle’s body load and road impact, maintain precise wheel positioning and optimal tire-to-road contact, and improve vehicle handling stability, driving safety and ride comfort while reducing abnormal tire wear. Each finished ball joint is composed of a housing, a ball pin, a ball seat, a sealing plate, a dust cover, snap rings, a protective cover and grease. Depending on the model, the product may also include nuts, bolts, spring washers and collars. The raw blanks for the housings and ball pins are imported from China to Thailand as unformed, unmachined blanks with no finished or semi-finished features. In Thailand, the carbon steel material is stamped by punch press to form a housing blank. The housing blank is then CNC machined to shape, including control of the housing internal hole, ball hole roundness and profile tolerance. Fixing holes are drilled using a vertical drilling machine, followed by surface treatment with a film to provide corrosion protection and a smooth, scratch-free surface. The ball pin is also processed in Thailand. The ball pin blank is machined on a CNC lathe to form the shank outer diameter, taper and related dimensional features. The ball pin for XNB20063 also undergoes thread rolling. The machined ball pin then undergoes spherical polishing to achieve a mirror finish. The processed ball joint housings and ball pins are then assembled with Chinese ball seats, sealing plates, dust covers, snap rings, protective covers, collars, nuts, spring washers, and Thai grease in Thailand. XNB30110 has a collar, while XNB20037 and XNB20063 do not require it. XNB20037 has no nuts, bolts, or spring washers. The finished ball joints then undergo quality inspection, packaging, and warehousing in accordance with standardized protocols.
subject: The tariff classification and country of origin of automotive ball joints

cleaned_description: the subject product is identified as Fabric Refresher Spray. It is described as a surface- active auxiliary washing preparation for textile substrates. It contains an organic nonionic surfactant (Laureth -3) and a chemical neutralizer to penetrate fibers, emulsify soils, and eliminate odors within the fabric matrix. This product will be imported in 22 FL OZ retail-ready plastic spray bottles. You state that there is specific chemical synergy between two primary components of the product’s chemical mixture: Laureth-3 and Sodium Bicarbonate. Laureth-3 is a non-ionic surface-active agent, which serves as the primary vehicle for this preparation. This surfactant actively reduces the surface tension of the aqueous solution. This mechanical reduction allows the liquid preparation to deeply wet and penetrate the tight, porous weave of textile or carpet fibers. Once inside the fiber matrix, the Laureth-3 physically emulsifies and suspends hydrophobic soils and organic particulates trapped within the substrate. By lowering the surface tension, the laureth-3 enables the sodium bicarbonate to physically reach deep-seated, trapped malodor molecules. Most stubborn fabric odors are composed of volatile organic acids. The sodium bicarbonate acts as a chemical neutralizer, undergoing an acid-base reaction that converts these volatile compounds into non-volatile, odorless salts.
subject: The tariff classification of Fabric Refresher Spray from China

cleaned_description: The products in question are pressure tanks used in various water pumping systems, including jet pumps, booster pumps, centrifugal pumps, and submersible pumps. The specific pressure vessel models are PWN-US-80LV, PWN-US-18LX, PWN-US-80LH, and SFN-US-325LV, with tank capacities ranging from 4.8 gallons to 85.9 gallons. The tanks have carbon steel exteriors and each includes an internal water chamber and air chamber pre-charged with pressurized air. The two chambers are separated by a flexible butyl rubber internal membrane, i.e., a diaphragm or bladder. The fixed diaphragm model tanks (PWN series) also include a polypropylene liner, and all tanks include water connections fittings, air valves, and an integrated support base. In operation, the tank is pre-charged at the factory with air pressure to create an internal air cushion. When the pump runs, water enters the tank, pushing against the diaphragm or bladder. As water enters, it compresses the air in the upper chamber, creating pressure. Once pressure reaches the system’s setpoint, the pump shuts off. When water is needed, the diaphragm or bladder uses the compressed air to physically push the water out without needing to activate the pump. When the pressure drops to the system’s cut-in level, the pump refills the tank and the cycle repeats.

cleaned_description: Descriptive literature was provided for our review. The item under consideration is the Fournier Rotary Press, which is a dewatering system for industrial and municipal sludge consisting of a sludge pump, a polymer tank, a polymer metering pump, a flocculator and a rotary press connected through a series of pipes, hoses, and electrical wiring. The sludge pump feeds sludge into the flocculator where it is combined with a pre-set ratio of polymer solution that enters the flocculator inlet by means of the polymer metering pump. Through a short period of agitation, the flocculator transforms the sludge and polymer solution into good quality “floc” (flocculated sludge), which is then directed to the rotary press. The rotary press is a circular channel delimited by parallel, rotating chrome-plated stainless steel filter elements on both sides. As sludge travels through the channel, filtrate (free water) is removed from the sludge by the filter elements and flows to a collection area at either side of the press where it is routed to a common outlet at the bottom of the unit. Due to the moisture being extracted, the sludge increases in density as it travels through the channel, being pushed along by the friction of the filter elements. A restrictor bar also exerts back pressure on the sludge by means of an air bellow system to keep the sludge from passing through the channel too quickly. The pressure the sludge exerts on itself as it becomes progressively more condensed, combined with the back pressure of the restrictor, ultimately forms the sludge into a dry, solid cake that is extruded through the channel outlet.
subject: The tariff classification of the Fournier Rotary Press from Canada

cleaned_description: The subject Automated Lumber Bundle Formation System is engineered to create lumber bundles. The lumber bundles are formed by an automated stacking machine that is positioned between upstream and downstream conveyors and other machines. Due to its overall size, the system will be imported as modules ready for assembly, with all modules imported in a single shipment. The first section consists of a series of conveyors referred to as two Haul Out Chain Modules, an Automated Lumber Distribution Module, and a Lumber Flow Accumulation Module. The Haul Out Chain Modules transport lumber from an upstream Sorter Module (not imported with the system) to the Automated Lumber Distribution Module, which is a chain-type conveyor mounted on a platform that moves horizontally on rails. This platform transfers lumber to the Lumber Flow Accumulation Module, a stationary chain-type conveyor that conveys the lumber to the Unscrambler. The Unscrambler arranges randomly accumulated lumber pieces into a parallel and evenly-spaced orientation, preparing them for downstream automated bundle-forming operations. This machine may be configured as a “single” or “double,” with the double configuration consisting of two single units stacked vertically, but otherwise identical in function. The next group of machines includes Speed Up Chains and Package Maker Accumulation Transfer Units, both specialized conveyors. The Speed Up Chains regulate the spacing, timing, and sequencing of lumber planks as they exit the Unscrambler. The Package Maker Accumulation Transfer Unit, a chain-type conveyor, arranges the planks according to specified bundle dimensions. This is accomplished by adjusting conveyor speed and buffering planks into organized rows, which are then transferred to the Package Maker for bundle assembly. The Package Maker is the core of the automated bundle-forming system, responsible for aligning, stacking, and bundling the incoming rows of planks. Incorporated into this unit are two submodules: the Pressing Foot module, which secures planks in place during bundling, and the Secondary Lift module, located in the lower section of the Package Maker. The Secondary Lift module lowers the assembled bundles, enabling the Package Maker to continue stacking rows and maintain uninterrupted automated stacking cycles. The final group of machines includes an Outfeed Bundle Synchronization Module, Package Outfeed Rollers, a Strapping Machine, a Strapping Machine Infeed Roller, a Strapping Machine Outfeed Transfer, a Package Doubler, and an Outfeed Package Transfer. The Outfeed Bundle Synchronization Module, Package Outfeed Rollers, Strapping Machine Infeed Roller, Strapping Machine Outfeed Transfer, and Outfeed Package Transfer are all conveyors. The Strapping Machine straps the bundles before they are conveyed to the Package Doubler, which stacks the bundles for retrieval by a forklift operator. The system also incorporates a Makeup Deck and Re-entry Bundle Sequencing Module to handle rejected or reprocessed lumber. Both units are chain-type conveyors designed to transport and reintegrate rejected lumber back into the system.
subject: The tariff classification of an automated lumber bundle formation system from Canada

cleaned_description: An ingredients breakdown, description of the manufacturing process, manufacturing flowchart, and a pictures of the product accompanied your letter. The product, “Dehydrated Black Garlic,” is described as fresh, whole garlic bulbs, containing no additional additives, sugar, water or preservatives, that undergo a multi-step manufacturing process in which the raw material undergoes an enzymatic hydrolysis and Maillard browning reaction. The black garlic bulbs are intended for human consumption for use as a snack and will be imported in a refrigerated condition in food-grade nylon vacuum pouches, sealed airtight within an industrial vacuum packaging machine to block oxidation and extend shelf life up to 12 months. The black garlic bulbs are said to be manufactured by first harvesting fresh, raw garlic bulbs and transporting them to the food processing plant. The garlic bulbs are evenly spread onto hot air circulation drying chambers in a recirculating air drying room at temperatures of approximately 25 degrees Celsius for 12 hours. This step reduces surface moisture to a target 12–15% epidermal water content. The next step involves taking what is described as the fully-dried raw garlic bulbs for a re-inspection process to remove any bulbs that developed surface mold during drying. Approved bulbs are restacked onto food-grade stainless steel wire mesh fermentation trays, which are transported into an insulated stainless steel industrial fermentation chamber room to undergo a fermentation process for a duration of 30-60 days. The shorter timespan provides a firm, lightly sweet black garlic bulb while the latter duration provides an ultra-soft, molasses-like bulb. The air temperature within the wall-mounted electric resistance heating elements is approximately 60 degrees Celsius with the chamber containing a relative humidity of approximately 90 percent. During this process, the fully-dried raw garlic bulbs undergoe enzymatic hydrolysis and a Maillard browning reaction inside the temperature/humidity-controlled fermentation room which is said to alter its appearance, flavor, moisture contents and other characteristics such as carbohydrates, protein and fiber. Allicin (sharp garlic pungency) breaks down into sweet, antioxidant S-allyl cysteine while sugars and amino acids react to form dark black melanoidins, eliminating raw garlic’s harsh bite. Once the 30–60 day fermentation cycle completeas, fully blackened garlic bulbs are still described as being extremely soft and sticky with high surface free moisture, which would cause rapid spoilage in sealed packaging. Trays are transferred back to the same recirculating drying chamber that occurred prior to the fermentation step for a secondary mild drying cycle at temperatures of approximately 45 degrees Celsius to stabilize surface moisture without reversing the fermented flavor profile. Qualified fermented black garlic bulbs are loaded into food-grade nylon vacuum pouches, sealed airtight on an industrial vacuum packaging machine to block oxidation and extend shelf life up to 12 months. Packaged finished goods are palletized and transferred to a refrigerated finished goods warehouse.
subject: The tariff classification of fermented black garlic bulbs from China

cleaned_description: Photographs and Descriptive literature were provided for our review. The item under consideration is described as the ARENA video game console, which utilizes a camera-free sensor array combining LiDAR and radar technology to track basketball shots with over 99% accuracy. The LiDAR system operates on the time-of-flight principle, emitting rapid, invisible pulses of laser light toward the court or backboard area. When a basketball or player interrupts the beam, the light reflects back to the sensor’s detector. By measuring the precise nanosecond travel time of the returning light pulse, the onboard processor calculates distance. This continuous stream of range and trajectory data maps the 3D coordinates of the ball’s movement, allowing the device to distinguish makes, misses, and shot distance entirely without optical video recording. The ARENA mounts to the top center of the basketball backboard, connects to LED strips around the outside edge of the backboard and plugs into an electric outlet. The device also connects to the huupe application which streams the game results to a television receiver, a monitor or other external screen or surface. Typical display configurations include outdoor television sets in the area of the hoop, computer monitors near the hoop, or portable devices like tablets, laptops, or phones being used to track gameplay in real time. The device comes pre-loaded with several games that allow players to compete against each other. These games include the number of three point shots made, number of consecutive shots made, number of “swishes”, etc. The ARENA also has internal parameters that interpret the tracked real-time physical activity in the context of the game. This means that the video game console not only sees from where a shot is attempted and whether it is successful but also interprets the data and creates output on an external screen that shows whether the attempt was a sufficient distance to be worth three points, or is of an appropriate distance to be a free throw.
subject: The tariff classification of the “huupe ARENA” system from China
